howto.what: 它把 Claude 每次 Read、Edit、Bash 变成压缩的 observation,session 结束时汇总摘要,相关的会自动注入之后的 prompt。第二个 session 起就带着前面的上下文,不用重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 同一项目里的第二次 session 开始注入记忆,第一次只负责铺底;也可运行 /learn-codebase 一次性把整个仓库灌进记忆(约 5 分钟,可选)。

say.note: 会解释 observation 的采集、注入与存放位置。

say.text: 运行 /learn-codebase 把整个仓库灌进记忆
say.note: 一次性前载整个仓库,约 5 分钟。

say.text: 这些记忆数据存在哪里?

howto.what_en: claude-mem turns each Read, Edit, and Bash into a compressed observation. Observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones auto-inject into future prompts, so your second session in a project starts with prior context.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. You can optionally run /learn-codebase to front-load a whole repo in one pass (~5 minutes).

say_en.note: Explains capture, injection, and where data lives.

say_en.text: Run /learn-codebase to load this repo into memory
say_en.note: Front-loads the whole repo in about 5 minutes.
